crash: Touch a file when anomaly detector is ready Using logs to detect if the anomaly detector is ready (as we did before) is unreliable and prone to failure if another system component has overly verbose logging. While logspam is a problem for the system, this test shouldn't fail because of it, as it is unlikely that anyone would connect the two. vm_tools: fix ASAN odr-violation in host binaries gRPC's libgpr is included in libgrpc. Applications using gRPC should explicitly link against libgrpc instead of libgpr since the former is a superset of the latter. smbprovider: Work around bug in smbc_rmdir() smbc_rmdir() is meant to return ENOTEMPTY if the directory is not empty, but instead returns success (https://bugzilla.samba.org/show_bug.cgi?id=13204). Work around by stat()ing the directory on success, and if that also succeeds, assume the directory was not deleted. BUG=chromium:1013901 TEST=Deploy to chell, directory deletion on SMB shares succeeds Change-Id: I4316a18ebc7018b19f79a252c6bd013d80820e6a Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1864589 Tested-by: Anand Mistry <amistry@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Anand Mistry <amistry@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sergei Datsenko <dats@chromium.org>
